scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Market cap = price × circulating. FDV (fully diluted valuation) = price × max supply.
scenes.vo: Circulating supply: tokens tradable now. Max/total supply: all that will exist. Market cap = price times circulating. F.D.V. (fully diluted valuation) = price times max supply. Unlocks/vesting: team and investor tokens released on a schedule; new supply that may be sold. Emissions: ongoing new tokens (rewards). Value capture: does protocol revenue actually reach token holders (fee share, buybacks), and how is it enforced?
scenes.cap: Circulating supply: tokens tradable now. Max/total supply: all that will exist. Market cap = price × circulating. FDV (fully diluted valuation) = price × max supply. scenes.sub: Price $2, circulating 100M, max 1B: market cap $200M, FDV $2B. Next month 50M unlock: circulating supply rises 50%. Unless demand grows to match, that's heavy selling pressure. A low market cap with a huge FDV is a warning.
